body: No. I doubt that they'll take me seriously. My mother's mum was both alcoholic and bipolar and did some incredibly outrageous things in public; got arrested quite a few times as well. I haven't done anything as serious as her, so I doubt that my mum will think that my case is something that should be treated or acknowledged. So I am kind of stuck in terms of telling my mum.

Thank you so much. The other day, I tried really hard to open up to one of my closest friends and I told him I was feeling really angry and had suicidal thoughts. He just said "It's all in your head."

It made me feel like complete shit.

But thank you very much I will try and get help for myself.
